metadata.title: A Dolbeault complex for the contact quantised flag manifolds of type $\mathrm{C}_{2}$ and $\mathrm{D}_{4}$
metadata.abstract: Differential calculi on non-irreducible quantised flag manifolds of the $\mathrm{A}$-series have recently been investigated using Lusztig positive root vectors, revealing that several features of classical differential geometry persist in the noncommutative setting. We extend this investigation to quantised flag manifolds associated with the lowest-rank quantum groups of types $\mathrm{C}$ and $\mathrm{D}$ whose classical spaces are holomorphic contact manifolds. Building on the Heckenberger--Kolb framework, we construct covariant first order differential calculi. The maximal prolongations of calculi restricted to contact directions have lower dimensions than their classical counterparts. In type $\mathrm{C}_2$, however, adjoining the Reeb direction yields a three-dimensional calculus on the contact flag manifold whose maximal prolongation has classical dimension. Adjoining the remaining simple-root direction yields a four-dimensional calculus on the full flag manifold, again with a maximal prolongation of classical dimension. For both calculi, we explicitly present the exterior algebras and identify them with those of the corresponding framing calculi on the quantum group. In type $\mathrm{D}_4$, we show that adjoining the Reeb direction yields a nine-dimensional calculus on the contact flag. We conjecture that its maximal prolongation also has classical dimension.

analysis.progressType: 量子旗流形的协变微分演算
analysis.workSummary: 在接触型 C₂ 与 D₄ 量子旗流形上构造协变一阶微分演算。仅限接触方向时最大延拓维数低于经典情形；C₂ 加入 Reeb 方向得三维演算，再加入剩余简单根方向得完整旗上的四维演算，两者外代数均显式且最大延拓具有经典维数。D₄ 中加入 Reeb 方向得九维一阶演算。
techniques: Reeb 方向扩张及外代数表示
analysis.breakthrough: 说明保留接触分布不足以恢复经典微分维数，而补足 Reeb 等方向可在 C₂ 恢复它。
analysis.limitations: D₄ 最大延拓具有经典维数在摘要中仅为猜想；九维一阶演算已构造不等于全部高阶外代数性质均已证明。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
